title: pvFastUniformGrid
body:
## pvFastUniformGrid

Synthetic source producing a 3-D uniform grid (image data) with cheap analytic point arrays: X (the x index, active scalars), optionally DistanceSquared (squared distance from the origin) and Swirl (the vector (y, z, x)). Use it for tests, benchmarks and demonstrations that need a predictable volume of adjustable size; use wavelet for a smoothly varying scalar field.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Values are computed from index coordinates (unit spacing, origin at index 0); they are not physical quantities.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FastUniformGrid`. Identity: `sources/FastUniformGrid`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DesiredBytesPerPiece` | The desired bytes per piece when the volume is split for SMP execution. When SMP is enabled, this is used to subdivide the volume into pieces. Smaller pieces allow for better dynamic load balancing, but increase the total overhead. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `EnableSMP` | Enable/disable SMP for threading. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateDistanceSquaredScalars` | Enable/disable DistanceSquared point data scalar array. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateSwirlVectors` | Enable/disable Swirl point data vector array. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `WholeExtent` | The six values in the property indicate the X, Y, and Z extent of the output data. The first two numbers are the minimum and maximum X extent; the next two are the minimum and maximum Y extent; and the final two are the minimum and maximum Z extent. The numbers are inclusive, so values of -10, 10, -10, 10, =10, 10 indicate that the dimensions of the output will be 21 x 21 x 21. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFastUniformGrid"
}
```
